The '''son''' of a dandy [[Unidentified Republic bureaucrat|bureaucrat]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], was toppled from power in a bloodless coup led by a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] named [[Magnus (starship captain)|Magnus]]. Magnus thus became the first [[Magnus (title)|Magnus]] of the [[O'reenian]]s.<ref name="UR 178">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
